verdict: Ads are efficient; leads need to convert before August's review.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 131 leads at $11.30 per lead — your most efficient rate in recent periods — driven almost entirely by the top Meta campaign, which carried 57% of total spend. The issue is downstream: those leads produced 87 open opportunities and zero booked appointments, meaning the gap is in intake, not in the ads. Separately, organic signals pulled back sharply this week, with Google Business Profile actions dropping over 50% versus the prior 7 days and website sessions down roughly 20%, pointing to a broader softening in unpaid discovery. We're working to stabilize the organic presence and are completing the final CRM and attribution setup items this week so the August scoreboard reflects every lead and appointment accurately.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days
cost per lead this period — down slightly from last week
drop in Google Business Profile actions over the past 7 days

watch_item.issue: Leads are coming in but no appointments are being booked, putting August results at risk.
watch_item.fix: CRM calendars and patient groupings are being finalized this week so every incoming lead routes correctly and can be tracked to a booked appointment.
